spell.asterismarcanum.starfire.guide: Launch a starfire bolt that pierces targets and ricochets toward nearby enemies.
spell.asterismarcanum.brightburst.guide: Bring forth a warding aura which pushes away nearby enemies.
spell.asterismarcanum.star_swarm.guide: Manifest a stellar array that continuously fires piercing light in your look direction.
spell.asterismarcanum.luminous_beam.guid: Converge eight prismatic rays into a piercing beam that continuously burns enemies ahead (100 mana/s base at level 1).
spell.asterismarcanum.piercing_light.gui: Summon seven white stars in a two-block-high cylinder above a magic circle. Stars seek living targets within 16 blocks, pierce up to five distinct targets, and leave white trails. Without a target they follow your casting direction; blocks or 40 blocks of travel end their flight.
spell.asterismarcanum.arcanum_starfire.g: Launch a piercing, ricocheting mote of starfire.
spell.asterismarcanum.arcanum_brightburs: Release a low-damage warding burst that pushes nearby enemies away.
spell.asterismarcanum.arcanum_star_swarm: Channel five astral gates that fire needles along your aim. The gates fade when channeling ends.
spell.asterismarcanum.arcanum_luminous_b: Channel a luminous beam up to 18 blocks, stopped by solid blocks.
spell.asterismarcanum.arcanum_piercing_l: Release three radial layers of luminous needles.
spell.asterismarcanum.arcanum_starcutter: Place an astral orb at the aimed location. It bursts after a short delay, with distance falloff and line-of-sight checks.
spell.asterismarcanum.silvery_barbs.guid: Protect allies, owned pets and summons in the aimed area for one second.
spell.asterismarcanum.celestial_tether.g: Anchor yourself in place and negate a limited number of hostile hits. Dismount or anti-magic to end it.
spell.asterismarcanum.astral_echo.guide: Teleport forward and leave a brief echo. Anti-magic erasing the echo pulls you back.
spell.asterismarcanum.summon_lunar_moths: Summon a rideable flying lunar moth for ten minutes. Recast to dismiss.
spell.asterismarcanum.astral_gateway.gui: Use the Stellar Periapt to carry players within 8 blocks to the Astral Sea, then cast again to return to each saved origin.
